description: This PHP class 'EmployeeDirectoryModel' in the namespace 'OrangeHRM\CorporateDirectory\Api\Model' models an employee directory object, extracting various employee-related properties for API serialization purposes. It implements the 'Normalizable' interface and uses traits for serialization. The class constructs an object that captures employee identification and organizational details, and defines which properties should be serialized via filters and attribute mappings.

classes.name: EmployeeDirectoryModel
classes.description: A model class representing employee directory information for API serialization, including properties such as employee number, name, job title, subunit, and location, constructed from an Employee entity.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EmployeeDirectoryModel with an Employee entity and sets serialization filters and attribute mappings.
